My First DMT Experience
When I smoked DMT along with Marijuana for the first time, I held it in until the experience started. I was smoking outside on the porch next to a forest. I heard and saw everything so much more clear. I thought I was in a rain forest, the wind sounded like a waterfall & the trees were so green & bright, the birds chirps sounded like music, the patterns on the table seemed so simple yet complex.
Unlike marijuana I wasn't tired at all; I had more energy. Colors were brighter & stranger; to me it seemed I saw everything the way it should be seen. The only bad thing is after the high was over I was extremely tired & fell asleep approximately an hour or so later. DMT is definitely something I'd enjoy trying again, also because it only last about 15-20 minutes.
Was trying to get a stronger trip. While we were smoking the DMT, our surroundings smelt like we were burning a pair of NIKEs.
[Reported Dose: '3-4 bowl hits']
